name: astur-mobile-examples
description: Convenience commands for Astur example test suites and inspector sessions.

scripts.help: node -e "console.log(['Available example commands:', '  npm run doctor', '  npm run devices', '  npm run devices:android', '  npm run devices:ios', '  npm run test:android', '  npm run test:ios', '  npm run test:ios:real', '  npm run test:parallel', '  npm run test:android:spec -- android-native/login.test.ts', '  npm run test:ios:spec -- android-native/login.test.ts', '  npm run test:parallel:spec -- android-native/login.test.ts', '  npm run codegen:android:emulator', '  npm run codegen:ios:simulator', '', 'Flutter demo app:', '  npm run test:android:flutter', '  npm run test:ios:flutter', '  npm run codegen:android:flutter', '  npm run codegen:ios:flutter', '  (Android Flutter requires ASTUR_FLUTTER_PROJECT=<path to the Flutter app source>; ASTUR_FLUTTER_PATH is optional if flutter is on PATH)', '  (iOS Flutter codegen expects assets/Runner.app: unzip assets/astur.demo.ios.simulator_flutter.zip -d assets/)'].join('\n'))"
scripts.codegen:android:emulator: npm --prefix .. exec astur-mobile -- codegen --android --device emulator-5554 --app ../assets/astur.demo.android.apk --app-id com.astur.demo
scripts.codegen:android:flutter: npm --prefix .. exec astur-mobile -- codegen --android --device emulator-5554 --app ../assets/astur.demo.android_flutter.apk --app-id com.astur.demo
